website.rationale: Homepage product copy remains accurate; the generated user guide receives the updated chapters when the release tag deploys. Privacy review found no new external collection, upload payload, consent trigger, recipient/provider, service configuration or retention/deletion policy. Tray manual checks reuse the existing explicit updater action; automatic preferences and request cadence are unchanged. New workbench menu snapshots and command selection IDs are local identity-scoped runtime metadata only, containing source/preset labels and availability, with no audio or measurement payload. Status presentation and Dock geometry do not add diagnostics fields or transmissions. The privacy wording and October 16, 2026 effective date are retained. Website screenshots are explicitly deferred below.

screenshots.rationale: Viewed the published hero, both Dock strips and all eleven homepage feature images. Images remain illustrative but are not a current 0.23.4 capture: the default Dock still shows its older Stats widths and 180 CSS px height, versus the new 150 CSS px default, and axis-label/indicator presentation can differ across the hero and panel images. The hero and amber/graphite/night/paper images retain the previously recorded Preset Default label. Retaking is deferred because the active RDP desktop is 1470x923 at 100% text scaling, below the official 1600x1000 hero and 2560-pixel-wide Dock capture requirements. No capture was substituted or represented as fresh. The Dock recipe and its regression test now follow the real 150 CSS px default (188 physical pixels at 125%); published images and their actual 2560x225 HTML dimensions remain unchanged until a valid recipe-driven capture and visual review can be completed.
